note: Twelve simulated strangers. Frozen before any run: sim/personas.sha256 is checked by run.mjs and analyse.mjs, and a mismatch refuses to report numbers. Requests are written as people actually type them - vague, abbreviated, occasionally misspelled - because a product that only works on clean queries has not been tested. day is an offset in days back from the run; two people with the same need do not have it on the same afternoon.
